load_mask_data_from_csv: load mask data from a HOT3D mask CSV file with timestamp, stream_id, and mask columns into a MaskData object
combine_mask_data_and_or: combine multiple MaskData objects using an and or or logical operator across all streams and timestamps
combine_timestamped_mask_data: combine multiple timestamped mask dictionaries with matching timestamps using an and or or operator
MaskData_stats: get statistics including length, num_true, and num_false for each stream in a MaskData object
MaskData_stream_mask: retrieve the timestamped mask dictionary for a specific StreamId from a MaskData object
